messages:
Maya (Growth): Quick ask — we need social execution for the Benchmark webinar: X threads + LinkedIn posts + retargeting creative. Drafts and asset owners?
Sam T (Content): I can draft copy. Thinking: 3 single X posts (tease/register/recap), 1 7-tweet thread with top data points, 2 LinkedIn variations (short announcement + long-form summary). Who owns video snippets?
Nina (Design): I can do short clips and quote cards. ETA Thu EOD for first pass. Need slides + any preferred timestamps for clips.
Oliver - Ops: Scheduling: I'll queue in Buffer. Target windows: NA lunchtime (12:30 PT) and EU afternoon (15:00 BST). Also: we should set UTM params and route registrants to SDR queue `webinar-bench` in HubSpot.
Maya (Growth): Nice. Also plan for retargeting: 1) engaged viewers (watched >30s) — 15s CTA clip to register; 2) link clickers — carousel of quotes. Nina, can you export 16:9 30s/15s/10s + 1080x1080 quote cards?
Nina (Design): Yep — 30s, 15s, 10s MP4s + 3 quote cards. Will pull slides. Ping me if you want specific frames. :+1:
Sam T (Content): Copy draft below — please iterate.
Sam T (Content): ```
X post 1 (tease): Data that surprised us: 42% of apps using LLMs saw >2x inference cost savings from batching. Join our webinar to learn how we measured it. 🔍 Register: https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=x&utm_campaign=bench
X post 2 (register): Last chance — seats for our benchmark webinar on Wed. Live demo + Q&A. RSVP: <link>
Thread (7 tweets): 1/7 TL;DR: We ran a cross-model benchmark focused on latency, cost, and quality. Key takeaways below. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
2/7 Method: 10 workloads, 5 model families, identical infra+batching profiles.
3/7 Latency: median p95 improvements when using smart KV cache + batching.
4/7 Cost: quantization + dynamic batching cut token unit costs by ~30%.
5/7 Quality: small regressions on niche prompts — we show when to prefer FP16.
6/7 Live demo in webinar: reproducible scripts + configs we used.
7/7 Sign up: https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=thread&utm_campaign=bench :rocket:
LinkedIn short: We ran a reproducible benchmark comparing latency, cost, and quality across modern open models — join our webinar for the full results and configs.
LinkedIn long: Long-form summary + link to blog post + CTA to webinar.
```
Maya (Growth): Looks good. Minor tweaks: add CTA for enterprise leads to book a demo (utm_source=enterprise_social) and mention closed captions on clips.
Oliver - Ops: Routing checklist:
- UTM: utm_source={platform}&utm_campaign=benchmark_webinar&utm_medium=social
- HubSpot form hidden field `lead_source` = social_bench
- SDR queue = webinar-bench
- Mark registrants with tag `benchmark_webinar_2025`
Nina (Design): Noted on captions. Will include burned-in captions for 15s/30s assets.
Sam T (Content): Updated short edits applied. Also propose pinned thread for live Q&A and a follow-up recap post the day after (include top 3 clips + link to recording).
Maya (Growth): Engagement follow-ups: immediate post-event email + 2 social follow-ups: Day+1 recap, Day+7 deep-dive blog CTA. Retarget ad set: registrants who didn't attend -> serve recap clip + on-demand link. :eyes:
SchedBot: Scheduled X posts for 2025-06-05T19:30:00Z (NA) and 2025-06-05T15:00:00Z (EU) — drafts pending approval.
Oliver - Ops: I'll assign Buffer drafts to @Sam T for final approval and to @Nina for attached assets. Once approved I'll enable UTM injection and turn on link tracking.
Sam T (Content): I'll do final approve by Thu 10am PT. Nina — will drop slides in this thread in 20m.
Nina (Design): Slides uploaded: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/xyz — pulling quotes now.
Maya (Growth): Perfect. After Sam approves, I'll coordinate paid retargeting segments with Ads team. Thanks y'all! :celebrate:
